experiment.title: Validate the isolated upstream Metal correctness fix
experiment.implementation: Separate m5-correctness source, manifest, server and operation tester are built. GPU math and model comparisons are held.
experiment.only_change: Apply upstream residual-source identity fix #30100 to m5-lab; no changed model or launch defaults.
experiment.hypothesis: The fused matrix-plus-residual operation must select the correct input; no TPS improvement is assumed.
prerequisites: Explicit testing go-ahead for any --run command
Offline validation receipt matches current sources
Quiet host; leave unrelated VM/build work alone
proof: MUL_MAT_ADD mm2+mm CPU-reference GPU check, plus existing math checks
Quality and zero-swap gates; report speed/latency without assuming a gain
stop_if: Unexpected quality failure or new swap
experiment.limits: Fix is absent locally and staged, but the current Qwen graph has not been proven to trigger the faulty fusion.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
